# Benchmark checklists

Each criterion is evaluated against what was actually produced. **pass**, **fail**, or **skipped** (with the reason;
render criteria are always skipped on the simulator).

## Every benchmark

| Id | Criterion |
| --- | --- |
| `plan_valid` | The plan validates |
| `build_ok` | Every required unit built |
| `qa_passed` | Project QA passed (8 checks) |
| `creative_no_errors` | Creative QA found no errors |
| `no_slideshow` | Not a slideshow, not zoom-only, no accidental boxes or blank shots |
| `unique_layers` | Source media untouched and layer names unique |
| `rendered` | A video file was rendered and verified |
| `render_qa` | Render-level creative QA (black frames, freezes, bars, clipping, silence, cut detection) |

## velocity — Velocity edit (military, aggressive, beat-locked)

> Make an aggressive military velocity edit "J20 STEALTH" for the fighter jet. Fast cuts on the beat, hard speed ramps, kinetic type, impacts on every drop, dark military grade.

```json
{
  "type": "velocity",
  "style": "military",
  "intensity": 0.9,
  "duration": 30,
  "seed": 7,
  "quality": "final",
  "resolution": "1080p",
  "overrides": {
    "beatSync": 0.95
  }
}
```

| Id | Criterion |
| --- | --- |
| `camera_moves` | >= 3 distinct camera moves across >= 3 families |
| `speed_ramps` | Multiple speed ramps with different shapes |
| `sfx` | Sound design: >= 10 events, >= 3 roles, an impact on the drop |
| `beat_sync` | Cuts on the beat grid (>= 85%) and a cut on the drop |
| `kinetic_type` | Kinetic typography |
| `advanced_transition` | At least one advanced transition (whip, zoom, glitch, light, ...) |
| `compositing` | A compositing scene (crop / layered / PIP / split) |
| `depth_camera` | A 2.5D / parallax / camera-driven scene |
| `colour` | Colour treatment applied |
| `intro_outro` | Cinematic intro (dark title) and ending (end card) |
| `pace` | Fast: median shot under 2.2 s |

## cinematic — Cinematic piece (slow, weighty, letterboxed)

> A slow cinematic piece "SILENT WINGS". Long dissolves, weighty camera moves, deep slow-motion, subtle sound, teal and warm grade, letterboxed.

```json
{
  "type": "cinematic",
  "style": "cinematic",
  "duration": 36,
  "seed": 3,
  "quality": "final",
  "resolution": "1080p"
}
```

| Id | Criterion |
| --- | --- |
| `slow_pace` | Slow: median shot >= 3 s |
| `restrained_transitions` | Dissolve-led transitions; no whips, glitches or distortion |
| `camera` | Cinematic rig: slow dolly / drift / orbit variety |
| `slowmo` | Slow-motion used sparingly (<= 40% of shots) |
| `quiet_sound` | Subtle sound design (< 0.6 events per second) |
| `colour` | CINEMATIC grade and letterbox |
| `intro_outro` | Title card in, end card out |
| `music` | Music chosen to suit (tempo 70-100 BPM) |

| Id | Criterion |
| --- | --- |
| `no_ramps` | No speed ramps |
| `plain_transitions` | Only cuts, dissolves and soft transitions |
| `calm_pace` | Shots are given room: median >= 3 s |
| `observational_camera` | Documentary rig, no shake or whips |
| `minimal_sound` | Minimal sound design (< 0.35 events per second) |

## commercial — Commercial (premium, controlled, brand-safe)

> A premium commercial "AURORA" for the new jet trainer. Clean controlled camera, hero details, light and zoom transitions, premium warm grade, professional.

```json
{
  "type": "commercial",
  "style": "premium",
  "duration": 30,
  "seed": 9,
  "professional": true,
  "quality": "final",
  "resolution": "1080p"
}
```

| Id | Criterion |
| --- | --- |
| `professional` | Professional mode: no glitch, distortion, kinetic or shake |
| `hero_shots` | >= 2 hero detail shots (crop / depth / callout) |
| `premium_transitions` | Premium transition vocabulary only |
| `product_camera` | Product rig: smooth orbit / push / reveal, no shake |
| `colour` | PREMIUM grade |
| `intro_outro` | Opening title and closing end card with the brand |
| `music` | Music in the 90-130 BPM band |
| `beat_sync` | Cuts on the beat (>= 80%) |
